listingLines: TRIPLE YOUR BATHROOM STORAGE: Turn the wasted space above your toilet into three shelves for towels, toiletries, baskets, and decor, freeing up counter space with no wall drilling required.
FITS STANDARD TOILETS: At 23 inches wide, 9.5 inches deep, and 60 inches tall, the open frame straddles most standard toilets, with about 37.5 inches from the floor to the bottom shelf.
45 LB PER SHELF: Each of the three wire shelves supports up to 45 lb, with about 9 inches between shelves for folded towels, bottles, bins, and baskets.
BRIGHT CHROME FINISH: The chrome-plated steel frame has a clean, polished look that suits any bathroom. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Rubber feet help protect floors from scratches.
EASY ASSEMBLY: This space saver goes together quickly, so you can go from unboxing to organized in no time. Use it for towels, toiletries, extra toilet paper, or decorative accents.
summary: This Honey-Can-Do 3-Tier Over-the-Toilet Bathroom Shelf provides triple your bathroom storage by utilizing the space above your toilet. It helps free up counter space by offering three shelves for towels, toiletries, and decor without requiring wall drilling.
highlights: Adds three shelves to your bathroom, turning wasted space above the toilet into storage.
Designed to fit over most standard toilets, measuring 23 inches wide, 9.5 inches deep, and 60 inches tall.
Each of the three wire shelves can support up to 45 lb, with approximately 9 inches of vertical space between shelves.
Features a bright chrome-plated steel frame with a clean, polished look and rubber feet to protect floors.
bestFor: Apartment dwellers who cannot drill into walls.
Organizing toiletries, towels, and decorative items.
stylingTips: Place folded towels and toiletries on the shelves for immediate access.
Use decorative baskets on the shelves to store smaller items and add visual appeal.
Arrange decorative accents on the shelves to personalize your bathroom space.

Confirm that the space above your toilet allows for approximately 37.5 inches from the floor to the bottom shelf.
Note that the shelf requires assembly; please check the listing for details on the assembly process.
